label: Finding-110
title: waf-nine-hours: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: Cloudflare's 'about 9 hours ahead' does not match its own 03:02 UTC: From 03:02 UTC to the first public artifacts (13:34Z) or the scheduled 14:00 UTC is about 10.5 to 11 hours. The claim id says nine hours; the claim text does not. | Vendors differ on pre-disclosure attack traffic: Cloudflare says it 'observed attack traffic targeting our customers' before the release; Imperva says that during pre-disclosure monitoring it 'observed no traffic matching the monitored PHP2Shell exploit patterns'. Different networks and patterns, so this is probably measures-differently, but the site should not cite either as general.
